description.zh: 要删除的访问控制策略组ID。
description.en: The ID of the ACL that you want to delete.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among all requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.
The region of the IPv6 translation service instance.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc delete-ipv6-translator-acl-list --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --acl-id ipv6transacl-bp1de20000 --region cn-hangzhou
